purpose: Context KB for camt.052 BankToCustomerAccountReport validation. For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and all possible fixes. Based on CBPR+ SR2025 Usage Guideline (camt.052.001.08) and SWIFT MX Enterprise KB.
reference_documents: SWIFT MX Enterprise LLM KB v2.0

iso_20022_rules.name: RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl
iso_20022_rules.description: If CopyDuplicate is present, then Related MUST be present. Related MUST contain the relevant BusinessApplicationHeader elements of the BusinessMessage to which this BusinessMessage relates.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrReportPaginationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: MessagePagination may be present or ReportPagination may be present, but not both.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Pagination may only be present at message or report level.

iso_20022_rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
iso_20022_rules.description: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction; the SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline (message-level SupplementaryData is removed).

iso_20022_rules.name: CurrencyAmount
iso_20022_rules.description: The number of fractional digits (or minor unit of currency) of any amount must comply with ISO 4217. The decimal separator is a dot. Applies to all ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount elements (Bal/Amt, Ntry/Amt, etc.).
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid currency code or too many decimal digits.

iso_20022_rules.name: ForwardBalanceAndAvailabilityRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If Balance/Type is equal to ForwardAvailable, then Availability is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for forward available balance.

iso_20022_rules.name: DomainOrProprietaryRule
iso_20022_rules.description: In BankTransactionCode (BkTxCd), either Proprietary or Domain or both must be present.

iso_20022_rules.name: BICFI
iso_20022_rules.description: Valid BICs for financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority and consist of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_FormalRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: If CopyDuplicate indicator is used in the Business Application Header (AppHdr/CpyDplct), it must be identical to the CopyDuplicateIndicator in the business document (Report/CpyDplctInd) when the latter is present.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_Identification_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: For agents: if BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, then Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed (ClrSysMmbId and LEI may complement); BICFI takes precedence on conflict. If BICFI is absent, (Nm & PstlAdr) OR [(Nm & PstlAdr) and ClrSysMmbId] must be present; exception: when Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent and all agents in between are within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Party_Identification_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: For Debtor/Creditor parties: if AnyBIC is present, then (Name and Postal Address) is NOT allowed (other elements remain optional); AnyBIC takes precedence on conflict. If Name is present, it is recommended to also use Postal Address.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Agent_PointToPointOnSWIFT
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: If the transaction is exchanged on the SWIFT network (instructing agent/sender and instructed agent/receiver are on SWIFT), then BICFI is mandatory and other elements (e.g. LEI) are optional.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Business_Service_Usage_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' (SR2025). This element is mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). Datatype changed to UsageIdentifierPatternText.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Business_Message_Identifier_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId (the Message Identification of the underlying group header).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Message_Definition_Identifier_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance, i.e. 'camt.052.001.08'.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Character_Set_Usage_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Character sets restricted as for pacs.008/pacs.009: all proprietary/text fields (excl. Nm/Adr for all actors and RmtInf) limited to FIN-X charset. Nm/Adr/RmtInf and proxy email extended with !#$&%*=^_`{|}~";<>@[\] (< as <, > as >).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_DateTime_Format
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: DateTime fields (CreDt, CreDtTm, Bal/Dt/DtTm, Ntry/BookgDt/DtTm, Ntry/ValDt/DtTm, FrToDt) must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset. Z suffix is forbidden by the pattern '.*(\+|-)((0[0-9])|(1[0-4])):[0-5][0-9]'.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Single Report Only
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Report (Rpt) maximum occurrence reduced to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 (base [1..*]). The number of occurrences of Report and Entries must be bilaterally agreed.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Bank-to-Bank and Bank-to-Customer
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: CBPR+ camt.052 covers both the Bank-to-Bank and the Bank-to-Customer legs and all payment instruments (not credit transfers / direct debits only); fewer restrictions are applied to elements than in the payment-instruction usage guidelines.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Electronic_Sequence_Number_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: For intra-day report: ElctrncSeqNb is the sequential number of the report assigned by the account servicer, increased incrementally by 1 for each report sent electronically. Recommended not to reset more often than once a day; reset/continuation is bilaterally determined.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_Indicator_TextualRule
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: If applicable, for Copy or Duplicate, the ElectronicSequenceNumber and LegalSequenceNumber must be the same as the original report.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: BrnchId Removed
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: BranchIdentification is removed from agent FinInstnId blocks (AppHdr Fr/To agents, Related Fr/To agents, account servicer and transaction agents) under CBPR+ SR2025.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Removed Building Blocks/Elements
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Removed under CBPR+ SR2025 include: AppHdr/BizPrcgDt, AppHdr/Sgntr, GrpHdr/MessagePagination, message-level SupplementaryData, plus numerous optional sub-elements across Report/Entry/EntryDetails/TransactionDetails (see Usage Guideline removed-elements list).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Account Currency Mandatory
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Report/Account/Currency (Acct/Ccy) is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1) under CBPR+ SR2025.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: Entry ValueDate Mandatory
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: Report/Entry/ValueDate (Ntry/ValDt) is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1) under CBPR+ SR2025.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules.name: ReferenceGuideline
cbpr_plus_formal_rules.description: At least one reference should be present in a ReportEntry to identify the underlying transaction(s).

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02 defined as mandatory).

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt, and optionally CharSet/MktPrctc/CpyDplct/PssblDplct/Prty/Rltd.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint (the account servicing institution / sender). When exchanged on SWIFT, must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI). If inconsistent, BIC takes precedence.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{sender_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Use the account servicer BIC (typically Report/Account/Servicer).

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint (account owner or party authorised to receive the report). When exchanged on SWIFT, must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI). If inconsistent, BIC takes precedence.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{recipient_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Use the BIC of the account owner / message recipient.

errors.description: AppHdr/To contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message. Must equal GrpHdr/MsgId (the Message Identification of the underlying group header).

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Copy the value of GrpHdr/MsgId and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{MsgId_value}</BizMsgIdr>.
If MsgId is also absent, generate a unique Max35Text value (e.g. RPT-YYYYMMDD-001).

errors.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr does not equal Document/BkToCstmrAcctRpt/GrpHdr/MsgId.
possible_fixes: Read GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value.
If BizMsgIdr is the source of truth, update GrpHdr/MsgId to match BizMsgIdr.
Never invent a new value — always harvest from the other field.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters.
Synchronize the truncated value back to GrpHdr/MsgId.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>camt.052.001.08</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root element (e.g. urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.052.001.08).
Extract the message identifier portion and set MsgDefIdr to 'camt.052.001.08'.
Ensure no trailing spaces or version mismatches.

tags.note: Minimum occurrence changed to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline. Datatype changed to UsageIdentifierPatternText.
tags.description: Business Service identifier. Mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025; must be 'swift.cbprplus.03'.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.03</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains an incorrect value (e.g. 'swift.cbprplus.02' from older release).
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.03' as mandated by SR2025.
Note: SR2024 and earlier used 'swift.cbprplus.02'; upgrade to .03 for SR2025.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset; Z suffix forbidden by the CBPR_DateTime pattern.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under the CBPR_DateTime pattern (a +/-HH:MM offset is mandatory).
AppHdr/CreDt lacks the mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset.

tags.description: Priority of the Business Message. Datatype changed to Priority2Code (NORM, HIGH).

errors.description: AppHdr/Prty contains a value not in the allowed code list (Priority2Code).
possible_fixes: Replace with 'NORM' (normal) or 'HIGH' (high priority).
Default to 'NORM' if priority is not specifically determined.

tags.description: Business Processing Date. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present.

errors.description: AppHdr/BizPrcgDt is present; this element is removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BizPrcgDt element from AppHdr entirely.

tags.note: Removed by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline. This information is available at the level of the SWIFTNet Header.
tags.description: Digital signature of the Business Entity. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present.

errors.description: AppHdr/Sgntr is present; this element is removed under CBPR+ SR2025 (signature handled at SWIFTNet Header level).
possible_fixes: Remove the Sgntr element from AppHdr entirely.

tags.description: Indicates whether the message is a Copy, a Duplicate or a copy of a duplicate. If used, must equal Report/CpyDplctInd when the latter is present (CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_FormalRule). If present, Related (Rltd) must be present (R1).

errors.description: AppHdr/CpyDplct does not equal Report/CpyDplctInd while both are present.
possible_fixes: Set AppHdr/CpyDplct and Rpt/CpyDplctInd to the same CopyDuplicate1Code value (CODU, COPY or DUPL).
Remove one of the indicators if the message is neither a copy nor a duplicate.

errors.description: CpyDplct is present but Rltd is absent; violates R1 (RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl).
possible_fixes: Add a <Rltd> block carrying the BAH elements of the related (original) message.
Remove CpyDplct if the message is not a copy/duplicate.

tags.note: Maximum occurrence reduced to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 (base [0..*]).
tags.description: Related Business Application Header(s). If used, must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message. Must be present when CpyDplct is present (R1).

errors.description: CpyDplct is present but Rltd is absent; violates R1.
possible_fixes: Insert a <Rltd> block carrying the BAH elements of the related (original) message.
Alternatively remove CpyDplct if the message is not a copy/duplicate.

errors.description: More than one Rltd occurrence present; CBPR+ SR2025 reduced maximum occurrence to 1.
possible_fixes: Keep only a single Rltd block; remove additional occurrences.

tags.description: Unique message identifier (point to point reference assigned by the account servicing institution). Must equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr. Limited to FIN-X character set.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgId>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</MsgId> as first child of GrpHdr.
Use format RPT-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g. RPT-20260528-001).
Ensure the same value is in AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters preserving meaningful prefix.
Synchronize truncated value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: MsgId contains characters outside the FIN-X character set (CBPR_RestrictedFINXMax35Text).
possible_fixes: Replace special/accented characters with ASCII equivalents.
Allowed: 0-9 a-z A-Z / - ? : ( ) . , ' + SPACE.

tags.description: Creation date and time of the message. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset. Z suffix forbidden by the CBPR_DateTime pattern.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: CreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix or lacks the mandatory +/-HH:MM offset; forbidden by the CBPR_DateTime pattern.
possible_fixes: Append a UTC offset if none is present.

tags.description: Party authorised by the account owner to receive information. Should only be identified when different from the account owner. If AnyBIC present, Name/PstlAdr not allowed; if Name present, PstlAdr recommended.

errors.description: MsgRcpt/Id/OrgId/AnyBIC is present together with Nm and/or PstlAdr; not allowed (AnyBIC takes precedence).
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when AnyBIC is present.
Or remove AnyBIC and retain Nm/PstlAdr.

tags.note: Removed by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline. Pagination, if used, is provided at report level (Rpt/RptPgntn).
tags.description: Message-level pagination. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present. (R4: message-level and report-level pagination are mutually exclusive.)

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgPgntn is present; this element is removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the MsgPgntn element from GrpHdr.
If pagination is required, use Rpt/RptPgntn (report level) instead.

errors.description: Both message-level (MsgPgntn) and report-level (RptPgntn) pagination present; violates R4.
possible_fixes: Keep pagination at report level only (Rpt/RptPgntn); remove MsgPgntn.

tags.description: Further details of the message. Datatype changed to CBPR_RestrictedFINXMax500Text.

errors.description: GrpHdr/AddtlInf exceeds 500 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 500 characters.

tags.note: Maximum occurrence reduced to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 (base [1..*]). The number of occurrences of Report and Entries must be bilaterally agreed.
tags.description: Account report block. Reports on a single cash account. Single occurrence only under CBPR+.

errors.description: Rpt block is absent; at least one Report is mandatory.
possible_fixes: Insert a <Rpt> block containing at minimum Id and Account (Acct).

errors.description: More than one Rpt block present; CBPR+ SR2025 reduced maximum occurrence to 1.
possible_fixes: Keep a single Rpt block; split additional reports into separate camt.052 messages (subject to bilateral agreement).

tags.description: Unique identification of the account report, assigned by the account servicer.

errors.description: Rpt/Id is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Id>{unique report identification, max 35 chars}</Id> as first child of Rpt.

errors.description: Rpt/Id exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters.

tags.note: Pagination only allowed when bilaterally agreed. R4: report-level and message-level pagination are mutually exclusive (MsgPgntn is removed under CBPR+). Sub-elements PgNb and LastPgInd are [1..1].
tags.description: Report pagination (PgNb, LastPgInd). Only present when agreed between parties.

errors.description: Report-level pagination present together with message-level pagination; violates R4.
possible_fixes: Keep pagination at report level only; remove GrpHdr/MsgPgntn (which is removed under CBPR+ anyway).

errors.description: RptPgntn present but PgNb or LastPgInd is absent.
possible_fixes: Provide both <PgNb>{page number}</PgNb> and <LastPgInd>{true|false}</LastPgInd> inside RptPgntn.

tags.description: Sequential number of the report assigned by the account servicer, increased incrementally by 1 for each report sent electronically. For Copy/Duplicate it must equal the original report's value.

errors.description: ElctrncSeqNb is not a valid number.
possible_fixes: Provide an integer/decimal Number value (e.g. 1).

errors.description: Rpt/CpyDplctInd indicates COPY/DUPL but ElctrncSeqNb differs from the original report.
possible_fixes: Set ElctrncSeqNb (and LglSeqNb) to the same value as the original report when sending a copy/duplicate.

tags.description: Date and time at which the report was created. If present, must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM with mandatory offset; Z forbidden.

errors.description: Rpt/CreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix or lacks the mandatory +/-HH:MM offset; forbidden by CBPR_DateTime pattern.
possible_fixes: Replace 'Z' with an explicit offset. Example: 2026-05-28T10:00:00Z → 2026-05-28T10:00:00+00:00.

tags.description: Indicates whether the document is a copy, a duplicate, or a duplicate of a copy. Must equal AppHdr/CpyDplct when both present (CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_FormalRule).

errors.description: Rpt/CpyDplctInd does not equal AppHdr/CpyDplct while both are present.
possible_fixes: Set Rpt/CpyDplctInd and AppHdr/CpyDplct to the same CopyDuplicate1Code value.
Remove one indicator if the report is neither a copy nor a duplicate.

errors.description: Rpt/CpyDplctInd is not a valid CopyDuplicate1Code.
possible_fixes: Replace with CODU, COPY or DUPL.

tags.description: Cash account to which credit and debit entries are made. Contains Id [1..1] (IBAN or Othr), Tp, Ccy (mandatory under CBPR+), Nm, Prxy, Ownr, Svcr.

errors.description: Rpt/Acct is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Acct><Id><IBAN>{valid IBAN}</IBAN></Id><Ccy>{ISO4217}</Ccy></Acct>.
If no IBAN, use <Id><Othr><Id>{account number}</Id></Othr></Id>.

tags.description: Account identification. IBAN preferred; otherwise Othr.

errors.description: Rpt/Acct/Id is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Id><IBAN>{valid IBAN}</IBAN></Id> or <Id><Othr><Id>{account number}</Id></Othr></Id>.

errors.description: Rpt/Acct/Id/IBAN fails ISO 13616 format or MOD97 checksum validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN: 2-letter country code + 2 check digits + BBAN (max 34 chars).
Verify MOD97 check digit computation. Example: DE89370400440532013000

errors.description: Both IBAN and Othr are present in Acct/Id; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Othr if IBAN is correct; remove IBAN if Othr is correct.

tags.description: Currency in which the account is held. Mandatory under CBPR+; ISO 4217 3-letter code.

errors.description: Rpt/Acct/Ccy is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <Ccy>{ISO 4217 code}</Ccy> inside Acct. Example: <Ccy>USD</Ccy>.

errors.description: Rpt/Acct/Ccy is not a valid ISO 4217 currency code.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

tags.note: Recommended; defines the account balances. Contains Tp [1..1], CdtLine [0..*], Amt [1..1], CdtDbtInd [1..1], Dt [1..1], Avlbty [0..*].
tags.description: Cash balance. R13: if Type = ForwardAvailable, Availability is not allowed.

errors.description: Balance Type is ForwardAvailable but Availability (Avlbty) is present; violates R13.
possible_fixes: Remove Avlbty when the balance type is ForwardAvailable.
Or change the balance type if availability information is required.

tags.note: Tp contains CdOrPrtry [1..1] (Cd is ExternalBalanceType1Code) and SubTp [0..1].
tags.description: Balance type. CdOrPrtry/Cd uses ExternalBalanceType1Code (e.g. OPBD, CLBD, ITBD, FWAV, PRCD, CLAV).

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/Tp is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Tp><CdOrPrtry><Cd>{balance type code}</Cd></CdOrPrtry></Tp>.
Use a valid ExternalBalanceType1Code, e.g. CLBD (ClosingBooked), OPBD (OpeningBooked), ITBD (InterimBooked).

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/Tp/CdOrPrtry/Cd is not in the ExternalBalanceType1Code list (max 4 chars).
possible_fixes: Use a valid ExternalBalanceType1Code (max 4 chars) or supply CdOrPrtry/Prtry.
Download the current external code set from www.iso20022.org to validate.

tags.description: Amount of money of the cash balance, with Ccy attribute. ISO 4217. Fraction digits must comply with the currency (R12).

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/Amt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Amt Ccy="{ISO4217}">{amount}</Amt>.

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/Amt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter code. Example: <Amt Ccy="USD">1000.00</Amt>.

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/Amt has more fractional digits than allowed for the currency (R12 CurrencyAmount) or an invalid currency.
possible_fixes: Limit fraction digits to the ISO 4217 minor-unit for the currency (e.g. 2 for USD, 0 for JPY).
Use a dot as decimal separator; max 18 total digits, 5 fraction digits.

tags.description: Indicates whether the balance is a credit or debit balance. A zero balance is considered a credit balance.

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/CdtDbtInd is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CdtDbtInd>CRDT</CdtDbtInd> or <CdtDbtInd>DBIT</CdtDbtInd>.

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/CdtDbtInd is not CRDT or DBIT.
possible_fixes: Replace with CRDT (credit/increase) or DBIT (debit/decrease).

tags.note: Choice: Dt (ISODate) or DtTm (CBPR_DateTime) via DateAndDateTime2Choice__1.
tags.description: Date (and time) of the balance.

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/Dt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Dt><Dt>{YYYY-MM-DD}</Dt></Dt> or <Dt><DtTm>{YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</DtTm></Dt>.

errors.description: Rpt/Bal/Dt/DtTm uses 'Z' suffix or lacks the mandatory +/-HH:MM offset; forbidden by CBPR_DateTime pattern.
possible_fixes: Replace 'Z' with an explicit offset, or use the date-only choice <Dt>YYYY-MM-DD</Dt>.

tags.description: Transactions summary: TtlNtries, TtlCdtNtries, TtlDbtNtries and TtlNtriesPerBkTxCd. Provides totals of entries reported.

errors.description: A summary amount (e.g. TtlNtries/Sum) has more fractional digits than allowed for the currency (R12).
possible_fixes: Limit fraction digits per ISO 4217 minor unit; use a dot decimal separator.

tags.note: Number of Entries to be bilaterally agreed. Contains Amt [1..1], CdtDbtInd [1..1], Sts [1..1], ValDt [1..1] (made mandatory), BkTxCd [1..1], NtryDtls [0..*], etc.
tags.description: Report entry — details on an individual entry. At least one reference should be present to identify the underlying transaction(s) (ReferenceGuideline).

errors.description: Entry has no reference identifying the underlying transaction(s) (ReferenceGuideline).
possible_fixes: Populate NtryRef or a reference within NtryDtls/TxDtls/Refs (e.g. EndToEndId, TxId, UETR) to identify the transaction.

tags.description: Amount of money in the cash entry, with Ccy attribute. Fraction digits must comply with the currency (R12).

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/Amt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Amt Ccy="{ISO4217}">{amount}</Amt>.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/Amt present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add a valid ISO 4217 Ccy attribute. Example: <Amt Ccy="EUR">250.00</Amt>.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/Amt has more fractional digits than allowed for the currency (R12).
possible_fixes: Limit fraction digits to the ISO 4217 minor unit; use a dot decimal separator.

tags.description: Indicates whether the entry is a credit or debit entry. Combined with RvslInd to determine the original operation direction.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/CdtDbtInd is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CdtDbtInd>CRDT</CdtDbtInd> or <CdtDbtInd>DBIT</CdtDbtInd>.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/CdtDbtInd is not CRDT or DBIT.
possible_fixes: Replace with CRDT or DBIT.

tags.description: Status of the entry on the books of the account servicer (e.g. BOOK, PDNG, INFO, FUTR).

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/Sts is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <Sts><Cd>{status code}</Cd></Sts> with a valid ExternalEntryStatus1Code (e.g. BOOK, PDNG, INFO, FUTR).

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/Sts/Cd is not in the ExternalEntryStatus1Code list (max 4 chars).
possible_fixes: Use a valid ExternalEntryStatus1Code (max 4 chars) or supply Sts/Prtry.
Download the current external code set from www.iso20022.org to validate.

tags.note: Made mandatory (min 1) by CBPR+ SR2025. Choice: Dt (ISODate) or DtTm (CBPR_DateTime).
tags.description: Value date — when assets become available (credit) or cease to be available (debit). Mandatory under CBPR+.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/ValDt is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <ValDt><Dt>{YYYY-MM-DD}</Dt></ValDt> or <ValDt><DtTm>{YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</DtTm></ValDt>.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/ValDt/DtTm uses 'Z' suffix or lacks the mandatory +/-HH:MM offset; forbidden by CBPR_DateTime pattern.
possible_fixes: Replace 'Z' with an explicit offset, or use the date-only choice <Dt>YYYY-MM-DD</Dt>.

tags.description: Booking date — when the entry is posted to the account. For booked entries this is the actual booking date.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/BookgDt/DtTm uses 'Z' suffix or lacks the mandatory +/-HH:MM offset; forbidden by CBPR_DateTime pattern.
possible_fixes: Replace 'Z' with an explicit offset, or use the date-only choice <Dt>YYYY-MM-DD</Dt>.

tags.note: Contains Domn [0..1] and Prtry [0..1]; R14 requires at least one (Domain or Proprietary or both).
tags.description: Bank transaction code — identifies the type/operation of the entry.

errors.description: Rpt/Ntry/BkTxCd is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert a <BkTxCd> block with a Domn (Domain) and/or Prtry (Proprietary) structure.

errors.description: BkTxCd present but neither Domn nor Prtry is present; violates R14 (DomainOrProprietaryRule).
possible_fixes: Add a Domn (Domain) structure with Cd and Fmly, and/or a Prtry (Proprietary) structure with Cd and Issr.

tags.note: Contains Btch [0..1] and TxDtls [0..*]. TxDtls carries references (EndToEndId, TxId, UETR), amounts, agents and parties of the underlying transaction.
tags.description: Entry details — batch and per-transaction details for the entry. Agent BICFI/Name and party AnyBIC/Name exclusivity rules apply inside TxDtls.

errors.description: An agent inside NtryDtls/TxDtls (e.g. DbtrAgt/CdtrAgt) has BICFI present together with Nm and/or PstlAdr.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from any FinInstnId where BICFI is present (BICFI takes precedence).

errors.description: A Debtor/Creditor party inside NtryDtls/TxDtls has AnyBIC present together with Nm and/or PstlAdr.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from the party when AnyBIC is present (AnyBIC takes precedence).

tags.description: Additional report information. Datatype restricted to CBPR_RestrictedFINXMax500Text.

errors.description: Rpt/AddtlRptInf exceeds 500 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 500 characters.

tags.note: Removed by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline at message level (R5).
tags.description: Message-level Supplementary Data. Removed under CBPR+; must not be present.

errors.description: Message-level SplmtryData is present; it is removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the message-level SplmtryData block.
If supplementary data is required, carry it within the appropriate transaction-level structure where allowed.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest MsgId from GrpHdr and set BizMsgIdr to same value or vice versa.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'camt.052.001.08' and match the Document namespace
AppHdr/CpyDplct must equal Report/CpyDplctInd when both present (CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_FormalRule)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Align both indicators to the same CopyDuplicate1Code value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If CpyDplct is present, Rltd must be present (R1)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the Rltd BAH block when CpyDplct is present, or remove CpyDplct.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: MessagePagination and ReportPagination are mutually exclusive (R4); MsgPgntn is removed under CBPR+
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove MsgPgntn; use Rpt/RptPgntn only when bilaterally agreed.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Report (Rpt) must occur exactly once (max occurrence reduced to 1)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep a single Rpt; split additional reports into separate messages (subject to bilateral agreement).
Populate Acct/Ccy with a valid ISO 4217 code.
Populate Ntry/ValDt with Dt or DtTm.
Remove Avlbty when balance type is ForwardAvailable.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BkTxCd requires Domain or Proprietary or both (R14)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Provide Domn and/or Prtry inside BkTxCd.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: All amounts must comply with ISO 4217 minor-unit fraction digits (R12)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Limit fraction digits per currency; use a dot decimal separator.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If agent FinInstnId/BICFI present, Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present in same block
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when BICFI is present (BICFI takes precedence).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If a Debtor/Creditor party AnyBIC present, Name and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when AnyBIC is present (AnyBIC takes precedence).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BrnchId is removed from all agent FinInstnId blocks under CBPR+ SR2025
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove all BrnchId elements from agent blocks.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: For Copy/Duplicate reports, ElctrncSeqNb and LglSeqNb must equal the original report (CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_Indicator_TextualRule)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set ElctrncSeqNb and LglSeqNb to the original report's values when CpyDplctInd indicates COPY/DUPL.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each ReportEntry should carry at least one reference to identify the underlying transaction(s)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate NtryRef or a reference within NtryDtls/TxDtls/Refs (EndToEndId, TxId, UETR).
